div.div:
Functional feature
User click on ad and get redirected to advertiser's website
Advitesers can query click metrics over time with 1 minute granularity
Out of scope
Ad targeting & serving
cross device tracking
integrations with offline channels
NFR:
support 10M ads on avg
10k ad clicks per second at peak
Low latency analytics queries < 1s
fault tolerance (dont cause click drops)
As realtime as possible
Idempotency of ad clicks
